first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and the inherited evidence indicates that simplifying signup and shortening onboarding durably improve early activation and time-to-value. This should address two current problems while supporting sustainable qualified revenue better than a short-term price response. Verify both records to confirm the effects remain durable and do not materially reduce lead or account quality; measure qualified revenue and retention, not just completion.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB-focused onboarding simplification test, prioritizing the documented onboarding-completion and activation declines. The evidence shows meaningful activation and completion gains, faster time-to-value, and improved retention from shortening onboarding, while signup simplification produced a small retention decline and was only validated for SMBs. Measure qualified revenue, activation, time-to-value, retention, and lead quality before expanding.
